Because I do not own this land, I must make it produce well enough to pay the rent and feed my family, so I will use improved maize seed and apply both organic manure and some chemical fertilizer. At my age, I cannot do all the weeding and heavy work alone, so I will hire labor for the hardest tasks and use herbicide to keep the weeds down. We have good rains here, so I do not need irrigation, but my children and I will still spend many days planting, applying inputs, and harvesting this small plot.
